answer: I would build the whole defence on Chartered millwright wheel log with millwrights endorsement: 4-year training, 175 supervised makings, field exam, guild dues, and no faster road exists. One proof costs 107 POA; 729 proofs cost 78003 POA, and the farm must pay before it earns anything. The vine is the signature, the ridge is the fee, and the nadir is the register where both are written down. This is the point: the cost falls on the attacker, never on the honest agent.
